intro: What clues hide in the art?
description:
Ready for a quick mystery between moments?

Look closely at illustrated scenes and let each prompt guide you toward a hidden clue. Ordinary-looking pictures may hide tiny oddities and easy-to-miss details.

How to play:
・Read the prompt
・Study the illustration
・Tap or select the one spot that answers the question

Each round is short, so it is easy to jump in during a break. Whether you enjoy visual puzzles, clue hunting, or simply taking your time with an illustration, this is a relaxed way to test your observation and spark of insight.

Can you uncover every clue?
